text: I had an encounter with a UFO here some time ago.
Yes, I did.
And you have pictures.
Yes.
Have those pictures been examined?
Yes, they are now.
Pardon?
They are now.
I see. And are they available?
Well, I really don't know. They're with the NEFON UFO study.
Oh, I see.
And they're under study now.
They're doing some kind of study with them.
I see.
But I imagine that they will be available for study
probably within the next four weeks, I imagine.
I see.
Now, you had quite an experience with that object.
I wonder if we could get a description of exactly what happened.
You mean the detailed...
Well, it was Sunday, January the 5th, and I was behind my house in a field getting ready to take some photographs.
Can you hear me okay now?
Yes.
And I hadn't taken any, and I turned around, and well, before that I heard electric sounds, something like an electric motor.
Uh-huh.
And I turned around and I seen the UFO there.
And it was, I would say, it looked about 100 feet in diameter and possibly 2,500 feet away from me.
I could say it could be farther or closer.
But it went over my brother's house.
It was the way I was looking at it, it did.
And it came almost completely over me.
Then it reversed and went back into another field, I don't know how far away.
And then it came over in another clearing, and then back into it, went over a kind of sort of like tree,
and into another clearing, and that's when I was taken aboard it.
Okay, now would you describe to that bit of being taken aboard just how it appeared to you?
Well, it appeared as if I was being pulled inside it at a terrific amount of speed.
Uh-huh.
And I found myself inside this room that was circular, about five feet diameter.
And on the lenses, I mean, excuse me, on the walls, there were these lenses that were kind
of somewhat like camera lenses, and they were glowing on and off with an orange color.
And there was a grate on the floor that was glowing on and off, too.
And these lenses, they were kind of, I would say, waist-high around them.
They weren't completely all over the inside of the room, but at a certain level,
all completely around me as far as I could see.
And I couldn't move except for my head.
I'm really not sure how long I was in the UFO,
but in that particular room, I would say about 30 seconds.
And then afterwards, I found myself back on the ground
close to the same position that I was when I was taken aboard it.
And my camera was off to the side of me.
Now, do you remember the type of opening that you...
Did you go through an opening going into the craft?
I don't remember.
All I remember is being pulled at a speed and then finding myself in the room.
I see.
And then you were returned in the same manner then?
Returned to the ground?
Probably somewhat the same manner.
I don't really know, because I was probably asleep or knocked out or something.
I see.
And then the craft, did it just leave after you went back to the ground?
Well, I didn't see it after I was put back on the ground.
I don't know how long, but I was out.
But it was gone when I got up.
My father said that telling that I was gone was really longer than what I said I was.
I see.
Because he said that I could have been inside it for a pretty long time because I was gone quite a bit.
How long did he feel that you were gone?
Well, he never did really say how long did he feel that I was gone, but the whole incident,
I would say, took around two or three minutes in my sense of time.
Yes.
But he says it could have been anywhere taken from 45 to 50 minutes.
I see.
But afterwards I come up to the house.
I was about 175 feet away from here, beside him.
And I told my father, and he kind of didn't believe me after first.
I tried to convince him.
He finally did believe me.
I called my brother.
He said I was pretty shook up about it.

The same day, at almost the same time, I believe, there was a sighting of the same craft, maybe the same craft, by something that used to be our neighbor that was visiting their parents about three-quarters of a mile away from here north.
Uh-huh.
And they was backing out of their driveway, or their parents' driveway, and getting ready to go home.
And the woman, she told her husband that she'd seen something kind of shiny back in the sky down here by our area.
And by the time she got turned around, it was gone.
I see.
Now, was there any sound from this craft that you heard at all?
Well, at first I heard an electric, like motor sound.
Yes.
But I don't recall hearing that while I was taking the pictures.
It was probably there, but I just didn't pay any attention to it.
Now, when you were aboard, did you hear any type of anything that would resemble voice communication,
or did you get any kind of communication of any kind when you were aboard?
You mean possibly telepathically or something?
Yes.
Well, not really. I kind of felt weird and funny that I hadn't felt before anything that
I hadn't felt since or had felt before that of somebody kind of being there. But otherwise
than that, there was no communication that I knew of.
I see. And has there been anything happen to you since that time, since your experience?
Well, what really do you mean?
Well, anything strange?
I had several dreams.
I see. And were these in relation to objects?
Yes. The same identical objects.
The same object.
Uh-huh. I was in my bedroom when I was asleep and I heard a noise and I looked outside and
here it was going around the house and I kind of hid underneath my bed and I was pretty
scared.
Uh-huh.
And several other ones pertained to just about the same thing.
I see.
And also, we have a dog.
It's an Airedale.
And my father, he really doesn't think that there might have been any effect on her, but
before I took the picture, she was pretty close to me.
She was about 100 feet away from me.
and close to a creek.
I hadn't seen her after.
I mean, I'd seen her before the sighting,
but I hadn't seen her during it.
And after the sighting, she's kind of act funny.
She hasn't had very much enthusiasm as what she did have.
She hasn't seemed much excited about anything.
Uh-huh.
What time was it that this experience took place?
What time of the day?
Probably around 2.30 p.m.
Uh-huh.
Probably around 2.30 or 3.30.
Possibly 2.30 or 3 o'clock.
Now, were those photographs, were they Polaroids or just a regular roll film?
They were 35mm.
I see.
And did they all come out fairly well?
Yes, except one, which they're studying now, a professional photographer in Bilbel, Illinois,
is reducing the size of it.
but they were overexposed quite a bit.
And the company that had developed the film is just like a store company,
and they didn't develop a certain photograph.
I guess they couldn't.
I see.
I had six photographs, really, counting that one that wasn't developed.
Have you ever talked about this with Dr. Hynek?
Yes, I have.
What is his conclusion?
Well, I really haven't been able to talk to Dr. Hynek since about three months ago.
And I was supposed to send him photographs and a detailed sheet of it, and I never was able to send it to him.
But I asked these people at NIVON to kind of relay the message to him, relay it to him.
Yes.
Sending the photographs.
But you really believe yourself then that you were actually taken aboard this craft through some means which you can't really explain?
Yes.
And then transported back to the ground?
Okay.
Uh-huh. Okay.
Now those photographs, we would like very much to get a copy.
Are they going to be available to research organizations?
Well, they're soon going to be available, some certain copies of them, about three copies
of the most clear one.
Yes.
Sending to Dr. Hynix.
And I imagine that if I told the organization that they could send some to you and to the
place in Highland, Illinois.
Illinois.
In as much as you've had
what we would refer to as a very classic
experience,
we're very interested in anything
that will happen,
unusual things that
would happen to you at any time in the future.
And
we'd appreciate hearing from you
either by phone
or by mail
in relation to this.
Now these photographs, would you like to have them sent to you by mail?
Yes, that would be fine. And of course we're willing to pay for what we get as long as the price is reasonable.
Phenomena Research is a very private, very small organization in Seattle.
and we're covering the entire Pacific Northwest.
And, of course, we learned about your experience by newspaper clipping.
It came a little bit late, but...
Where was yours sent from?
Pardon?
Where did you receive yours from?
It was from the union in Vandalia.
Did they send one to you?
No, we had it picked up through a clipping service.
They send clippings on UFOs from all over the country.
This is a going thing for our records.
But I'm going to have them reproduce the rest of them in 8x10s.
Fine.
We're going to, next time, I would like to have my negatives back for just a short time to get some reproduced on my own.
Uh-huh.
a private copying agency up here.
I see.
I do quite a bit of business there.
But I will have a summary produced for you then.
Very good.
And have them send it to you.
Fine. Very good.
Okay.
And we sure appreciate it, and it's been a pleasure talking to you.
Okay.
And keep in touch if anything special happens to you.
What do you mean? Weird or...
Anything that...
Any new experience that you think is directly associated with your first encounter.
Thank you very much.
Goodbye.
